channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about TJ McConnell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about TJ McConnell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on TJ McConnell
item.description:
The scrappy Kolek finished with 16 points and 11 assists, both career highs, in 26 minutes and was sent a message by coach Mike Brown to embrace the defensive mindset of the opposing point guard from Thursday night — Indiana’s TJ McConnell.

“And I’m not comparing all small white guys with each other when I give TJ McConnell as an example. But I say, look, this dude has been in the league for [what feels like] 30 years. And it’s because of his toughness first, especially defensively,”

Mike Brown on TJ McConnell, Dec 19, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell, Andrew Nembhard, Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Tony East:Rick Carlisle on defense in the final minutes:

“McConnell, Nembhard, Mathurin, these guys did a great job defensively tonight. Mathurin's defense has taken a real step forward this year. He's taken matchups, he did a really great job on Giddey... this is part of the growth process.”

Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell, Andrew Nembhard, Bennedict Mathurin, Nov 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Enrique Freeman on TJ McConnell
item.description:
“So I'm just grateful for the year, really. TJ McConnell, he told me, 'Just be grateful.' I think that's why I said that word. That's one of my words to describe the year. He was telling me, 'I've been in the league 10, 11 years, and this is my first time making it to the Finals. It takes a lot of hard work, a lot of dedication.' Just being grateful and enjoying the moment, that was something a lot of the older guys say. Enjoy these moments.”

Enrique Freeman on TJ McConnell, Jul 28, 2025. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell
item.description:
Dan Devine:Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell:

“He was great in the third. Put him back in earlier than normal. He was very tired, that's why we got him out. And I think there was a play early in the fourth where it looked like fatigue had set in there.”

Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell, Jun 16, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Reece Beekman on TJ McConnell, Derrick White
item.description:
Reece Beekman:

“I like guys like Derrick White. He’s pretty good. I think TJ McConnell for the Pacers, he’s a pesky guard who gets in the lane, makes plays on offense, and defense just picks it up full court. Just making it hard on the other teams’ guys. Just trying to learn different stuff from them so I can use this offseason.”

Reece Beekman on TJ McConnell, Derrick White, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Josh Hart on TJ McConnell
item.description:
Josh Hart on comparisons to TJ McConnell:

“We have a lot of comparisons obviously. [I’m] a little taller, more handsome, better taste in wine, probably golf better.”

Josh Hart on TJ McConnell, May 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: LeBron James on TJ McConnell
item.description:
Speaking on his Mind the Game podcast with JJ Redick, the Lakers star expressed his love for McConnell's game, even comparing him to another genius-level basketball player in Draymond Green.

“One of my favorite players in the NBA right now is T.J. McConnell,”

LeBron James on TJ McConnell, Apr 12, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Myles Turner on TJ McConnell
item.description:
Turner on McConnell:

“I think he takes it personal when he sees white boys guarding him. That's just another thing I see from him too. He wants to be THE white boy.”

Myles Turner on TJ McConnell, Apr 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Doc Rivers on TJ McConnell
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Doc Rivers on TJ McConnell:

“Before he was just a pest. Now he's a pest who can shoot the ball.... He's actually looking to shoot more which I think has made him even a better player.”

Doc Rivers on TJ McConnell, Mar 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell
item.description:
Scott Agness:Carlisle:

“The priority is to get the new staff in here, work towards good health as much as we can, try to get McConnell and McDermott re-signed if we can do that.”

Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Jun 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell
item.description:
#Pacers president Kevin Pritchard on soon-to-be FAs McConnell and McDermott:

“They're core to what we've done. They're two feet in on the Pacers. They were super thankful for Nate. ... There's certain roles they're good at. At times we probably played them too much.”

Kevin Pritchard on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart
item.description:
Redick:

“In my little circle of T.J. McConnell, Doug McDermott, Tobias Harris and Josh Hart, it was usually me. But Josh has got some great Bordeaux in his collection. But he also had some shipped in. The last night I was there, I didn’t have enough room in my luggage to transport all of the wine back home to New York. So I brought six or seven bottles to the Grand Floridian hotel. I had a little wine meal with Timothé Luwawu-Cabarrot, Russell Westbrook, Doug, TJ and myself. Then (former Pelicans coach) Alvin Gentry and (Orlando Magic general manager) John Hammond happened to be sitting at the table next to us. So I shared a couple of sips with them.”

JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart, Sep 21, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Nate McMillan on JaKarr Sampson, TJ McConnell
item.description:
McMillan on the injury report after 2nd scrimmage (all but Goga practiced today):

“We had no injuries. TJ McConnell tweaked his shoulder in the game last night but he is OK. JaKarr had some back spasms but he's feeling OK”

Nate McMillan on JaKarr Sampson, TJ McConnell, Jul 27, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on TJ McConnell
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Pierce on McConnell, who he coached at while on the bench in Philly:

“I walk out there already & he's talking shit to me. He's ready. It's a personality. It's an attitude. You cant just be a defender and just show up. You got to bring something. You got to be nasty.”

Lloyd Pierce on TJ McConnell, Jan 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Joel Embiid, TJ McConnell
item.description:
Sam Hinkie:

“What overachieving for T.J. McConnell means is very different than what overachieving for Joel Embiid means because of the gifts that they have. But people who have a real grittiness but don't take themselves too seriously, and are really realistic and are everyday learners, I can't get enough of those people, honestly.”

Sam Hinkie on Joel Embiid, TJ McConnell, May 23, 2018. Source: Philly Voice.

item.title: Brett Brown on TJ McConnell
item.description:
Brown on TJ McConnell:

“He was the MVP of the game. He wears his heart on his sleeve. I have a very antagonistic relationship with him. I coach him harder than I coach anybody. I'm so proud of him coming out of left field, being in the NBA, staying in the NBA and now playing in the NBA.”

Brett Brown on TJ McConnell, Dec 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @JCameratoNBCS.
